title: 10 Profitable KDP Niches in 2026
content:
Introduction

The Amazon KDP marketplace offers incredible opportunities for self-publishers looking to build passive royalty income streams. However, high-earning authors focus on high-demand, low-competition subcategories.

Niche 1: Somatic Anxiety Workbooks

Mental wellness and nervous system regulation books continue to dominate non-fiction bestseller lists. Buyers actively seek practical, guided daily exercises.

Niche 2: Color by Number Geometric Mosaics

Adult coloring books featuring stress-relief numbered geometric patterns enjoy strong repeat purchase rates.

faqItems.question: What is the most profitable KDP niche in 2026?
faqItems.answer: Based on our cross-category BSR analysis, somatic anxiety workbooks and adult geometric coloring books consistently generate the highest monthly royalties relative to competition saturation.

faqItems.question: Do I need design skills to publish low-content puzzle books?
faqItems.answer: No. Tools like KDP Studio allow you to generate 300 DPI print-ready word searches, coloring plates, and full spine wrap covers automatically.
